title: Firewall
subtitle: Control who can reach your server from the internet. Apply a preset or add your own rule.
protected_ports_notice: ℹ️ Rules affect only new connections — your open sessions (SSH/panel) are not dropped. Critical ports {{ports}} cannot be closed for safety.
template_mysql_desc: Closes the database port (3306) to the internet. MySQL is reachable only from inside the server.
template_ftp_desc: Closes FTP port (21). If you use SFTP, FTP can safely be disabled.
template_mail_desc: Closes SMTP/POP3/IMAP ports. If you don't run a mail server, this reduces spam-relay risk.
template_rpc_desc: Closes rpcbind (111) and NFS (2049). Disable if you don't use file sharing.
step1_label: 1 · What do you want to do?
dynamic_ip_warning: ⚠️ Warning: This port will only be open to the IP above. If your IP is dynamic (home/mobile ISP), you may lose access when it changes. Port 22 (SSH) stays open so you can still log in to remove the rule — or use a static IP.
no_rules: No rules yet — the server is open to all connections.
no_rules_hint: Apply a preset above to get started.
added: Rule added and applied to firewall.
preview_close_with_port: Port {{port}} will be closed for EVERYONE (except whitelisted IPs).
preview_ban_with_port: IP {{ip}} will be BLOCKED from accessing port {{port}}.
preview_ban_no_port: IP {{ip}} will be BLOCKED from all ports.
preview_whitelist_with_port: Port {{port}} will be open only to {{ip}} — everyone else is BLOCKED (allowlist).
preview_whitelist_no_port: IP {{ip}} will be ALLOWED on all ports (priority access).
mode_ban_desc: Block a specific IP. If you enter a port, only that port is blocked; leave empty to block ALL ports.
mode_ban_example: Example: completely block 45.9.1.2 which keeps brute-forcing SSH.
mode_whitelist_desc: If you enter a port, that port will be open ONLY to this IP(s) — everyone else is blocked (allowlist). Leave the port empty to give this IP priority access to all ports (evaluated before bans).
mode_whitelist_example: Example: enter port 8443 with your office IP → only you can reach the panel.
mode_close_desc: Close a port to EVERYONE (except whitelisted IPs). Critical ports (SSH/web/panel/DNS) are protected and cannot be closed.
mode_close_example: Example: close database port 3306 to the outside world.

autoban.title: Automatic Intrusion Blocking
autoban.desc: Watches authentication attacks against SSH, mail and FTP services and temporarily blocks IPs that cross the threshold. Disabled by default.
autoban.threshold_hint: How many failed attempts before blocking (minimum 3).
autoban.window_hint: The period over which attempts are counted.
autoban.whitelist_note: Allow-listed IPs and the server's own addresses are never blocked.
autoban.confirm_clear: All automatic bans currently in effect will be removed. Rules you added manually are left untouched. Continue?
autoban.clear_failed: Automatic bans could not be cleared
autoban.badge_title: This rule was added by the intrusion watcher; it lifts itself when it expires.
